identity.name: Mshta.exe Spawned From Browser Process
identity.summary: An attacker uses a browser process to spawn mshta.exe, which is a common technique for executing malicious scripts. Cortex should detect this behavior as suspicious.

biocs.name: Mshta Spawned From Browser
biocs.description: Detection of mshta.exe being spawned directly from a browser process
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name in ('chrome.exe', 'firefox.exe', 'iexplore.exe')
| filter action_process_image_name = 'mshta.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'mshta.exe'
